readings: Join each advanced behaviour record to its trade record (via translink) and that trade's trader, keeping only records where both exist. For each trader type, count the advanced behaviour records (each row of the advanced behaviour table counts once, even if several rows refer to the same trade record), and compute its share of the total count across all trader types. Take the average of those per-type counts across the trader types that appear. Keep only the types whose count is strictly above that average. In one row, return the sum of their counts, the average of their shares, and the average amount by which their counts exceed the overall average count. Do not round.

Join each advanced behaviour record to its trade record (via translink) and that trade's trader, keeping only records where both exist. For each trader type, count the distinct trade records that have at least one advanced behaviour record (a trade record with several behaviour rows counts once), and compute its share of the total distinct-trade-record count across all trader types. Take the average of those per-type counts across the trader types that appear. Keep only the types whose count is strictly above that average. In one row, return the sum of their counts, the average of their shares, and the average amount by which their counts exceed the overall average count. Do not round.
queries:
WITH per_type AS (
  SELECT t.tradekind AS tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM advancedbehavior a
  JOIN transactionrecord r ON a.translink = r.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
tot AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM per_type
)
SELECT SUM(p.cnt) AS total_count,
       AVG(p.cnt * 1.0 / tot.total) AS avg_share,
       AVG(p.cnt - tot.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess
FROM per_type p, tot
WHERE p.cnt > tot.avg_cnt;
WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT t.tradekind AS tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS cnt
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM type_counts
),
avg_c AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM type_counts
)
SELECT
  SUM(tc.cnt) AS total_count,
  AVG(tc.cnt * 1.0 / total.total_cnt) AS avg_share,
  AVG(tc.cnt - avg_c.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess
FROM type_counts tc, total, avg_c
WHERE tc.cnt > avg_c.avg_cnt;
